decision_rule: Launch only if every required gate passes. Unknown access/identity/license/independence is not a pass.

launch_gates.requirement: Document exact eligible population, prior human/agent/model access, role disjointness and sample identities; UNKNOWN fails fresh status. An internal log has a declared custody scope, not universal proof.

Preserve failed So2Sat v2 and PovertyMap screens. Their protected targets stay closed. Any later study needs its own approved design, fresh eligible calibration evidence and a new lock before access; do not change a completed screen post hoc.
Bind class map, label convention, official/alternative metric, fixed model pair, adapter state and common predictor/comparator information budget. Null quantities and missing methods stay explicit.

Predeclare cluster population and plausible transfer assumptions. At alpha=.10, n_cal>=9 is necessary for a finite ordinary split-conformal rank, not sufficient for calibration validity, precision or useful routing.

Before outcomes, freeze source/candidate/predictor, fit/tune/calibration/target roles, weight 5 primary loss, primary comparison, minimum relevant effect, matched-exposure procedure, cluster inference and multiplicity. Attach sample-size/precision rationale and executable no-leakage checks.
Pin source release and usable license/access terms, bind local file/checkpoint/runtime identities using authorized stages, and separate code/evidence publication from raw-data redistribution.
Declare wall-clock, 16 GiB memory, disk/cache and output bounds using a development-only pilot. No paid compute, physical cameras or dataset acquisition in this metadata task.
All prior gates must pass and root must review the candidate and executable lock before one bounded study launches. Do not execute on a merely proposed or resource-feasible candidate.

finite_rank_check.scope: Necessary combinatorial condition only. Does not establish exchangeability, conditional validity, nine independent deployments, power, or nontrivial actions.

assumptions: Any later pilot must fit 16 GiB unified memory and declare wall-clock, peak memory, scratch/cache and output limits before launch.
Internal free space is limited; T9 capacity does not imply adequate I/O, container completeness, runtime compatibility, or fresh provenance.
Do not translate published V100 runtimes into M5 runtime promises.
No physical-camera data collection or production/field deployment is included.
